content:
alex: Heads-up — planning to flip the quantized kernel (v3-quant-abi) in eu-west-1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This is a non-breaking ABI but we saw a perf variance in canary warm workloads. Want to coordinate a conservative ramp with throttles and explicit fallbacks.

maria: +1. What are the metrics we want to watch? p95 latency, error rate, gpu memory OOMs?

alex: p95 latency, token/s throughput, and anomaly count (decoder OOMs). Target: < 5% p95 regression and < 0.1% error increase. If either breaches in two consecutive 5-min windows we throttle to 20%.

sam: can we do a soft cap at 30% for the first 30m then 60% after 1h? We had a flare on long-context earlier.

ian: prefer deploybot-managed ramp. We can set a deploy policy:
```
policy: "ramp"
initial_traffic: 0.3
ramp_steps: [30m->0.3, 60m->0.6, 120m->1.0]
safety_checks: [p95_latency, error_rate, oom_rate]
```

priyanka: Add a TTL for fallback so if deploybot rolls back we pin previous kernel for 2h for stability.

deploybot: Deploy request received: quant-kernel:v3-quant-abi -> eu-west-1
Status: queued. Planned rollout window: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC -> 02:30 UTC
Actions: ramp-policy=ramp; auto-throttle=enabled; rollback-on=[p95_latency>5% for 2 windows,error_rate>0.1%]

sre-oncall: FYI I will be watching traces and hot shards. Set me as primary pager if p95 spikes >20%.

maria: Also add a per-model-family pin override for multigen and chat-small models. They hit edge cases with quant packing.

alex: Good call. Command to apply pin if needed:
```
deploybot pin --region eu-west-1 --kernel quant-kernel:v2-stable --duration 2h --reason "post-failure rollback"
```

sam: If we need to throttle mid-rollout, use this:
```
deploybot throttle --region eu-west-1 --version v3-quant-abi --max-traffic 0.2
```

priyanka: Please update release notes with known risk (long context >8k may see +10% latency). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/2026-03-21-quant-v3 (draft)

ian: Will wire up canary dashboards and alert thresholds. Adding a temporary trace tag: quant-rollout-v3

alex: OK — plan agreed. Maria/Priyanka/SRE on call. Deploybot scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Ping here when the rollout starts and when we hit ramp steps. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Rollout started: quant-kernel:v3-quant-abi -> eu-west-1. Traffic=30% -> monitoring enabled.

sre-oncall: seeing a small p95 bump +6% at 02:08. Observability: tail latency on long-context requests. Starting throttle to 20% now.

deploybot: Throttle applied: Traffic reduced to 20% for quant-kernel:v3-quant-abi in eu-west-1

maria: Thanks. Watching.

sre-oncall: After throttle, p95 stabilized to +2%. No OOMs. Keeping at 20% for 15m then re-evaluate.

alex: If stable at +2% after 15m, we can step to 40% and continue ramps. If anything else, prepare to pin v2.

priyanka: Update: release notes pushed to draft with the rollback command and mitigation steps.

deploybot: Rollout update: traffic ramp paused at 20% per manual throttle. No automatic rollback executed.

alex: Great job team. Closing thread once we finish the ramp. Will create postmortem if we end up pinning.
